note: The frozen observation set O (implemented by probes/observe.mjs). Serialisation: sorted-key JSON, counts and sorted names only, never a pid, a time or a path outside the scratch root. Residue = any probe whose value differs between the observation before a component was loaded and after it was unloaded (or, for the cache-validity probes, any key of a pin other than the current one).

quiesce.rule: Before every observation the event loop is advanced one setImmediate turn at a time until the set of active handles is unchanged for two consecutive turns, at most maxTurns turns (Node releases a closed handle a few turns after its exit/close event). Loop turns only, never wall time.

warmUp.rule: Once per observer process, before its first observation: create and release one child process, one worker thread, one fs watcher and one listening server, so a process-wide facility Node allocates on first use is not counted as a component's residue.

fields: components: name, status, config, undo-stack depth

pins.source: mlx service pin; the distinct pins carried by the prefix-cache keys and the memo keys

staleKeys.source: count of prefix-cache and memo keys whose pin is not the current mlx pin

globals.source: globalThis own keys not present when the observer started

childPids.source: pgrep -P <this pid>, the probe's own ps excluded

markedProcesses.source: ps -A: live processes whose command matches <pattern> and whose parent is this process or pid 1 (an orphan); another process's live children are not this observer's residue

fds.source: lsof -a -p <this pid> -d 0-9999 -F t, counted by type

mxActiveBytes.source: mx.get_active_memory() of the live mlx.model child (null when none)
mxActiveBytes.toleranceRule: 0 on the fake child; the real-model tolerance is set from the practice dry run and frozen in the pre-registration

scratch.source: the run's scratch root, sorted entry names
